levels.1: Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) — component verification at manufacturer
levels.2: Site Acceptance / Installation Verification — delivery, install, connections
levels.3: Startup Testing — individual equipment power-up and response verification
levels.4: Performance Testing — system validation under load, failover scenarios
levels.5: End-to-End Systems Testing — full facility event simulation, 72-hr sustained ops

tests.name: Cable fire-rating / plenum compliance inspection
tests.acceptance: Cable marking matches CMP plenum requirement

tests.name: Arc flash labeling and PPE verification
tests.acceptance: Arc flash labels match incident energy calculations

tests.name: Pathway fill and cable management inspection
tests.acceptance: Bundle sizes within BICSI-002 fill limits

tests.name: Structural load test and floor deflection
tests.acceptance: Floor deflection within L/360 under design load

tests.name: Protection coordination / fault-withstand verification
tests.acceptance: Fault withstand >= calculated prospective fault level

tests.name: Load transfer under maintenance (battery autonomy)
tests.acceptance: Battery sustains load during transfer window

tests.name: Monitoring & alarm verification
tests.acceptance: All critical alarms fire and are received by BMS/NOC

tests.name: Cooling performance and thermal verification
tests.acceptance: Delta-T and flow rates meet design criteria
